_README: Hand corrections applied by build_maps.py to the Geocodio export in
data/public receptacles.csv. Keyed on the exact 'Address' string in that
file, so a correction covers every row carrying that address.
A null 'lat' drops the row: the address cannot be placed at all.
These were found by comparing each row's input address against the address
Geocodio actually matched. Where a street number or name vanished in the
match, the row was re-geocoded against OpenStreetMap (the node or crossing
two named streets share, via the Overpass API). Rows whose coordinates look
soft but not wrong -- a street-center fallback that still lands on the right
street in the right ward -- were left alone rather than guessed at.
